Vegan scones, cake and a pot of tea in Lady Bay.

A relaxing, welcoming vegan tearoom with a full cake counter, plus a shelf of hand drawn gifts for the home.

Ring to reserve a tableVegan High Tea

100%vegan since January 2022

The cake counter is vegan too.

A full counter of cakes and bakes, and not one of them has dairy or egg in it. A few from the tearoom:

  • Fruit scones with coconut cream and jam
  • Millionaire’s shortbread
  • Chocolate tiffin cake
  • Raspberry, yoghurt and coconut cake

“To name but a few.” Ask at the counter for what is in today. Please tell the team about any allergies or intolerances.

Vegan High Tea

£16.95per person
  • A selection of sandwiches
  • A scone with coconut cream and jam
  • A selection of cakes
  • A pot of tea

Book in advance, at least 24 hours ahead. Gluten free can be catered for, just say so when you book. Cakes may vary from those pictured.

Ring to book: 0115 945 5792

Hand drawn gifts for the home.

Next to the cake counter there is a shelf of cushions, mugs, candles, macramé and wire sculptures, to suit all budgets. Pop in for a browse.

Have your pet drawn on a cushion.

Pets on cushions are the most popular commission. Linsey will also draw a favourite sports personality or singer. There is no online shop, so come in or get in touch to talk it over. Lisa also takes commissions for macramé plant hangers.

Email about a commission0115 945 5792

Run by Linsey and Lisa.

After trialling a vegan month in January 2022, they decided to go 100% vegan. They were excited to see so many customers trying plant based alternatives and enjoying them.

The menu is colourful, tasty, healthy and cruelty free. Linsey and Lisa always appreciate feedback, and if you are ever dissatisfied, they would like you to come and have a chat.

Linsey and Lisa
